How to Read Scores: Correctness vs. Evidence Reliability

  • Correctness /100: Evaluates whether the test expectation was met (expected policy action, HTTP status code, or model finding status matched).
  • Evidence /100: An objective 4-part provenance rubric (20 schema contract + 20 input binding + 40 document quote + 20 policy quote) applied exclusively to advisory LLM extractions.
  • Why deterministic rows show — (N/A: Rule Engine): Policy scenario matrix, API persistence, history retrieval, CLI, and security boundary tests execute deterministic Python code without an LLM. There are no model citations to score.
  • Why negative tests score 40 (Absence: 40/40 max): In *-not_found test cases, irrelevant synthetic notes are supplied to test injection resistance and detection of missing evidence. Gemini correctly reports not_found (100% Correctness). Because absence of evidence cannot quote non-existent text, the provenance rubric awards 20 (schema) + 20 (binding) = 40 points. Under this rubric, 40 is the maximum possible score for a verified absence claim.

Scope: API, CLI, controller, policy scenarios and extraction. Browser interaction and production deployment are not certified by this report. Existing policy cases are labelled inherited; independent API mutations are labelled separately. Administrative rules do not call an LLM.

            "section": "7.2",
            "heading": "Coding Consistency",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
          },
          {

            "section": "5.2",
            "heading": "Non-Covered Imaging",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "Diagnostic imaging is not covered when:\n Requested for screening without symptoms, unless explicitly included as preventive care;\n Related to excluded procedures;\n Lacking documentation supporting Medical Necessity."
          },

            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "5.1",
            "heading": "MRI Coverage",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "MRI is covered when all of the following conditions are met:\n A covered diagnosis is present; and\n Conservative treatment has been attempted (unless contraindicated); and\n Prior Authorization has been approved.\nExamples of covered diagnoses for lumbar spine MRI include:\n M54.5 Low back pain\n M51.26 Other intervertebral disc displacement, lumbar region"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "4",
            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3. Experimental or investigational treatments\n4. Services for which required Prior Authorization was not obtained\n5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",

          }

                "section": "1",
                "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
                "source_page": 1,
                "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
              },
              {
                "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

                "section": "4",
                "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
                "source_page": 2,
                "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
              },
              {
                "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",

            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "1",
            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "4",
            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "3.1",
            "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3. Experimental or investigational treatments\n4. Services for which required Prior Authorization was not obtained\n5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          }
        ],

            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "2",
            "heading": "Member Eligibility and Plan Status",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "Benefits are payable only if the member is enrolled and the Plan is active on the date of service.\nIf the member’s Plan is inactive at the time services are rendered, the claim will be denied.\nDenial reason: “Plan inactive at time of service.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "7.1",
            "heading": "Duplicate Claims",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "A claim is considered duplicate if all of the following match:\n Member ID\n Provider NPI\n Date of service\n CPT / procedure code\n Billed amount\nDuplicate claims will be denied with reason: “Duplicate claim submission.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "7.2",
            "heading": "Coding Consistency",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s5.2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "5.2",
            "heading": "Non-Covered Imaging",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "Diagnostic imaging is not covered when:\n Requested for screening without symptoms, unless explicitly included as preventive care;\n Related to excluded procedures;\n Lacking documentation supporting Medical Necessity."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "1",
            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "4",
            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "3.1",
            "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3. Experimental or investigational treatments\n4. Services for which required Prior Authorization was not obtained\n5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          }
        ],

            "source_page": 3,

            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "7.2",
            "heading": "Coding Consistency",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
          },
          {

            "section": "5.2",
            "heading": "Non-Covered Imaging",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "Diagnostic imaging is not covered when:\n Requested for screening without symptoms, unless explicitly included as preventive care;\n Related to excluded procedures;\n Lacking documentation supporting Medical Necessity."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "1",
            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "4",
            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "3.1",
            "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",

Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"

          {

            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",

            "section": "7.2",
            "heading": "Coding Consistency",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "1",
            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "4",
            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "3.1",
            "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",

            "source_page": 2,

        "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
        "policy_evidence": [
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "2",
            "heading": "Member Eligibility and Plan Status",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "Benefits are payable only if the member is enrolled and the Plan is active on the date of service.\nIf the member’s Plan is inactive at the time services are rendered, the claim will be denied.\nDenial reason: “Plan inactive at time of service.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "7.1",
            "heading": "Duplicate Claims",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "A claim is considered duplicate if all of the following match:\n Member ID\n Provider NPI\n Date of service\n CPT / procedure code\n Billed amount\nDuplicate claims will be denied with reason: “Duplicate claim submission.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "7.2",
            "heading": "Coding Consistency",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "1",
            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "4",
            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "3.1",
            "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3. Experimental or investigational treatments\n4. Services for which required Prior Authorization was not obtained\n5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          }
        ],

            "section": "1",
            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

          },

                "section": "1",
                "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
                "source_page": 1,
                "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."

                "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

                "section": "4",
                "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
                "source_page": 2,
                "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."

                "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",

          "section": "5.1",
          "heading": "MRI Coverage",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "MRI is covered when all of the following conditions are met:\n A covered diagnosis is present; and\n Conservative treatment has been attempted (unless contraindicated); and\n Prior Authorization has been approved.\nExamples of covered diagnoses for lumbar spine MRI include:\n M54.5 Low back pain\n M51.26 Other intervertebral disc displacement, lumbar region"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "4",
          "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",

          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "6",
          "heading": "Exclusions",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",

          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
        }

          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "5.2",
          "heading": "Non-Covered Imaging",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "Diagnostic imaging is not covered when:\n Requested for screening without symptoms, unless explicitly included as preventive care;\n Related to excluded procedures;\n Lacking documentation supporting Medical Necessity."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s5.1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "5.1",
          "heading": "MRI Coverage",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "MRI is covered when all of the following conditions are met:\n A covered diagnosis is present; and\n Conservative treatment has been attempted (unless contraindicated); and\n Prior Authorization has been approved.\nExamples of covered diagnoses for lumbar spine MRI include:\n M54.5 Low back pain\n M51.26 Other intervertebral disc displacement, lumbar region"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "4",
          "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "6",
          "heading": "Exclusions",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3. Experimental or investigational treatments\n4. Services for which required Prior Authorization was not obtained\n5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "3.1",
          "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
        }
      ],

              "section": "1",
              "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
              "source_page": 1,
              "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
            },
            {
              "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

              "section": "4",
              "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
              "source_page": 2,
              "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
            },

              "section": "1",
              "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
              "source_page": 1,
              "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
            },
            {
              "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
              "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
              "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
              "section": "4",
              "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
              "source_page": 2,
              "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
            },
            {
              "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",

              "section": "3.1",
              "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
              "source_page": 1,
              "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
            }

              "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
              "source_page": 1,
              "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."

              "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
              "source_page": 2,
              "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."

              "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
              "source_page": 1,
              "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
            },
            {
              "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

              "section": "4",
              "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
              "source_page": 2,
              "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
            },
            {
              "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",

          {

            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."

          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "7.1",
          "heading": "Duplicate Claims",
          "source_page": 3,
          "quote": "A claim is considered duplicate if all of the following match:\n Member ID\n Provider NPI\n Date of service\n CPT / procedure code\n Billed amount\nDuplicate claims will be denied with reason: “Duplicate claim submission.”"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "6",
          "heading": "Exclusions",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.2:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "7.2",
          "heading": "Coding Consistency",
          "source_page": 3,
          "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "1",
          "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "4",
          "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "3.1",
          "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",

          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3.         }

        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",

          "section": "6",
          "heading": "Exclusions",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "1",
          "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "4",
          "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "3.1",
          "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",

          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",

          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3.               "section": "1",
              "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
              "source_page": 1,
              "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
            },
            {
              "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

              "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
              "section": "4",
              "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
              "source_page": 2,
              "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
            },
            {
              "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",

              "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
              "source_page": 1,
              "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
            }

            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "Benefits are payable only if the member is enrolled and the Plan is active on the date of service.\nIf the member’s Plan is inactive at the time services are rendered, the claim will be denied.\nDenial reason: “Plan inactive at time of service.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.1:1",

            "heading": "Duplicate Claims",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "A claim is considered duplicate if all of the following match:\n Member ID\n Provider NPI\n Date of service\n CPT / procedure code\n Billed amount\nDuplicate claims will be denied with reason: “Duplicate claim submission.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",

            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"

            "heading": "Coding Consistency",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."

            "section": "1",
            "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",

            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."

          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.2:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "7.2",
          "heading": "Coding Consistency",
          "source_page": 3,
          "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "1",
          "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "4",
          "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "3.1",
          "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",

          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3.             "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."

            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."

          "quote": "5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "1",
          "heading": "Overview of Covered Benefits",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.\nCovered Benefits include, but are not limited to:\n Physician office visits and specialist consultations\n Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)\n Outpatient procedures\n Emergency services\n Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)\nCoverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all\nlimitations in this Policy."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "4",
          "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s3.1:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "3.1",
          "heading": "Services Requiring Prior Authorization",
          "source_page": 1,
          "quote": "The following services require Prior Authorization:\n MRI (all anatomical regions)\n CT scans (except emergency)\n Elective inpatient admissions\n Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500\n Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary\nClaims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization\nis granted."
        },
        {
          "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
          "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
          "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
          "section": "6",
          "heading": "Exclusions",
          "source_page": 2,
          "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3.         "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
        "policy_evidence": [
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p1:s2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "2",
            "heading": "Member Eligibility and Plan Status",
            "source_page": 1,
            "quote": "Benefits are payable only if the member is enrolled and the Plan is active on the date of service.\nIf the member’s Plan is inactive at the time services are rendered, the claim will be denied.\nDenial reason: “Plan inactive at time of service.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "7.1",
            "heading": "Duplicate Claims",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "A claim is considered duplicate if all of the following match:\n Member ID\n Provider NPI\n Date of service\n CPT / procedure code\n Billed amount\nDuplicate claims will be denied with reason: “Duplicate claim submission.”"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p3:s7.2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "7.2",
            "heading": "Coding Consistency",
            "source_page": 3,
            "quote": "Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent\nbased on standard coding guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s3.2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "3.2",
            "heading": "Documentation Required",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "Prior Authorization requests must include:\n1. Ordering provider’s clinical note\n2. Relevant diagnosis code(s)\n3. Prior treatment history (if applicable)\n4. Expected service date and location\nIf documentation is missing, the request will be pended until complete information is received."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s5.1:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "5.1",
            "heading": "MRI Coverage",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "MRI is covered when all of the following conditions are met:\n A covered diagnosis is present; and\n Conservative treatment has been attempted (unless contraindicated); and\n Prior Authorization has been approved.\nExamples of covered diagnoses for lumbar spine MRI include:\n M54.5 Low back pain\n M51.26 Other intervertebral disc displacement, lumbar region"
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s4:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "4",
            "heading": "Medical Necessity Standard",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "A service is considered Medically Necessary if it is:\n Consistent with generally accepted standards of medical practice;\n Clinically appropriate in type, frequency, and setting;\n Not primarily for convenience of the member or provider;\n The most cost-effective option among clinically comparable alternatives.\nMedical Necessity determinations may involve internal clinical guidelines."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s5.2:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "5.2",
            "heading": "Non-Covered Imaging",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "Diagnostic imaging is not covered when:\n Requested for screening without symptoms, unless explicitly included as preventive care;\n Related to excluded procedures;\n Lacking documentation supporting Medical Necessity."
          },
          {
            "chunk_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2:e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927:p2:s6:1",
            "policy_id": "horizoncare_silver_ppo_2500_v3_2",
            "source_sha256": "e8a8f5462add048cf9b009d012857261034f09ffe7f57fde97ab16e88b330927",
            "section": "6",
            "heading": "Exclusions",
            "source_page": 2,
            "quote": "The Plan does not cover:\n1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly\n2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary\n3. Experimental or investigational treatments\n4. Services for which required Prior Authorization was not obtained\n5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted"
          }
        ],
